# Kitchen Experience \| New catalog

[News](https://www.newform.it/en/news-page/news) \- 02/03/2026


![](https://www.newform.it/media/07-news/2026/KItchen%2026/new-kitchen-catalog-2026_1_new.png)

There comes a moment when a kitchen transforms from a functional space into an experience. It is where daily gestures meet design, where materials converse with light, and where design becomes part of life itself.

Newform presents the new [Kitchen Experience catalogs](http://www.newform.it/en/catalogs), born from this vision: a continuous evolution that elevates the kitchen into a contemporary, sophisticated, and coherent experience. Functionality remains central, as does the reliability that has always defined the brand, while design now takes a further step forward, achieving a confident, distinctive modernity.

**Evolutions that take shape, innovations that inspire, collections that open new possibilities.**

![](https://www.newform.it/media/07-news/2026/KItchen%2026/new-kitchen-catalog_alkimia.png)

Within this journey, [**Alkimia**](http://www.newform.it/en/kitchen/alkimia-en) expands its design language. New configurations have been created for those seeking maximum visual clarity. The [remote control](http://www.newform.it/en/alkimia-en/73306-sink-mixer-tap-with-swivel-spout-and-remote-control-for-purified-water), separate from the mixer, lightens the aesthetic of the worktop while maintaining the full functionality that defines the series. This is complemented by the [traditional mixer version](http://www.newform.it/en/alkimia-en/73304-sink-mixer-tap-with-swivel-spout), which preserves the collection’s signature style, making Alkimia even more versatile and universally appealing.

![](https://www.newform.it/media/07-news/2026/KItchen%2026/new-kitchen-catalog_moony.png)

[Moony](http://www.newform.it/en/moony-kitchen/3101) follows the same design philosophy, now introducing **a double outlet for purified water**. This solution combines technology and convenience in a single gesture while maintaining the series’ formal balance and the softness of its lines.

The new catalogues also present a new finish: **Groove Bronze**. Bold and tactile, it enhances the warm tones of bronze through a strong, almost artisanal brushing—bringing a contemporary interpretation of tradition to kitchens with character.

![](https://www.newform.it/media/07-news/2026/KItchen%2026/new-kitchen-catalog_steel-line.png)

[Steel Line](http://www.newform.it/en/kitchen/steel-line), the new 316 stainless steel series, also makes its debut. With a fluted handle, slim levers, and versatile configurations—from the traditional spout to the pull-out spray and the bold front version—Steel Line brings elegance and practicality to both contemporary and professional kitchen projects.

The catalogue concludes with a section dedicated to what often makes the difference: details. **Kitchen Details** invites a closer look at finishes, design, accessories, and functional solutions.

The new Kitchen Experience catalogues tell a clear story: the kitchen as a complete, coherent, and elegant environment—a contemporary suite in which every choice is the result of design, research, and a passion for detail.

Newform is an Italian company that produces [faucets](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_bathroom-taps), [mixers](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_kitchen-taps/features_kitchen-mixer-taps), [shower heads](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_overhead-showers), as well as [sanitary ware](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_washbasins-and-bathroom-fixtures) and [accessories](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_bathroom-accessories) to create a complete look in the bathroom. The company caters to a private as well as a contract audience, with a wide range of customization options, both in terms of finishes and dimensions. All stages of production are in-house, from design, construction of handmade prototypes to machining and final production. Product design is sophisticated, materials are of high quality, and factory technology is optimized to be as environmentally friendly as possible.

## Newform, Made in Italy faucets for bathroom and kitchen

Newform's catalog is definitely wide and the range of [faucets for bathroom](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_bathroom-taps) and [kitchen](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/categories_kitchen-taps) is able to satisfy any taste and need: shapes, styles and finishes are designed to adapt to any environment and bring added value to the home decor. [Extro](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_extro) is a particularly wide collection, which is well suited to different markets: luxury is never an end in itself, but rather combined with design-conscious shapes.

[Daytime](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_daytime) is characterized by a great refinement of forms and a certain inspiration from the British style: the return to the classic is represented by the presence of two handles, for the separate regulation of hot and cold water, but the collection is at the same time made contemporary by a large number of finishes from which you can choose. [Linfa](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_linfa-ii) is the collection with a minimalist and refined spirit, yet plays with soft lines and colors, while [Ergo](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_ergo-kitchen) is dedicated to pure and essential forms. [Nio](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_nio) is a collection that was created to meet first and foremost the demands of practicality, but its elegant and functional form also conquers from an aesthetic point of view: the formal simplification of the round-section body and the angled spout allows you to create combinations of different shapes. [Blink](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_blink) is elegant and modern, accessible and quality: the handle is revisited in detail to achieve a perfect balance of thickness, proportions and aesthetic cleanliness. [Park](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_park-limited-edition) revisits the discreet taste of neoclassical tradition in a modern key: clean and regular lines are combined with material elements, creating pure and full volumes; the control has a pentagonal shape, making it original and ergonomic at the same time. The [X-Steel 316](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_x-steel-316) collection was born from the desire to create an attractive, solid and easy-to-use product. It is a product made of stainless steel, a noble material with unparalleled properties, which meets the highest quality standards due to its durability, unalterability, hygiene and eco-friendliness. The minimalist design fits easily into all environments. While [Ergo-Q](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_ergo-q) aims to break the patterns of the past through a design with a rigorous, square shape. Finally, [Aqualite](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/collection_aqualite) is a special collection for Newform, designed by architect [Alberto Apostoli](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/designers/alberto-apostoli): transparencies of light and water give life to geometric shapes that, through recessed showerheads, merge with the structure and offer waterfalls, and flush-to-wall control systems that modify the material surface through a sign of light.

## Newform for You, the exclusivity of a tailor-made service

Newform for You is the exclusive service that allows the company to design and manufacture items that meet the needs and desires of individual customers, adapting to the demands of the various markets in which it operates and allowing architects to create tailor-made projects. Thus, they range from the timeless style of [chrome-plated steel](https://www.archiproducts.com/en/newform/products/material_stainless-steel) to the more opulent gold, via brushed bronze and up to matte black, which makes for a modern and metropolitan environment. As far as finishes are concerned, there are more than 30 possible combinations, allowing you to choose, for example, the classic galvanic bath or the more modern PVD treatment, with its many shades of color and great resistance to abrasion. The latest, on the other hand, is Exclusive Metal, a finish inspired by the automotive world and allowing for scratch- and fingerprint-resistant surfaces. To satisfy the most demanding, colored inserts and **Swarovski crystals** can also be added.
